insights.summary: Invoca offline call conversions reach Google Ads one to three days after the call, so Smart Bidding optimizes on incomplete data.
insights.quote: So the Google Ads offline conversions. We're seeing them land one to three days after the call. Sometimes two days, sometimes three.

insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Every time we get to renewal, they look at the bill and there's the base, then PreSense, then the QM seats, then AI Voice Agent minutes stacked on top.
